title: Phase 5: tools fan-out (MVP)
description: supervisor.py eager sweep + readiness event, catalogue.py (tools), router.py (tools/call).
acceptance_criteria: test_startup, test_aggregation, test_tools_call, test_dead_backend pass; usable from Claude Code
close_reason: supervisor.py (eager concurrent sweep, readiness event, required-backend refusal), catalogue.py (per-backend cache, list_changed invalidation, skipped-name recording), router.py (the per-method dead-backend policy). Wired into gateway.py. 260 tests green. Verified live: 3 backends configured, 2 running, 1 skipped with a readable reason; namespaced tools routed correctly through the real bridge; no secret in the log. Found: the gateway must not declare client capabilities before the passthrough handler exists — MCPStdioClient's conformance guard refuses a promise with nothing behind it.

title: Phase 3: WS daemon, zero backends
description: jsonrpc.py, transport_ws.py (lifted, de-ACP'd, path routing /mcp vs /admin), session.py, minimal gateway.py, admin.py (list_backends), tests/fixtures/ws_client.py.
close_reason: jsonrpc.py, transport_ws.py (lifted, de-ACP'd, /mcp + /admin path routing, Bearer accepted), session.py, gateway.py composition root, admin.py with the four meta-tools, tests/fixtures/ws_client.py. Daemon wired into cli.py with SIGHUP/SIGTERM handling. 205 tests green; live daemon verified end to end. Found and fixed: websockets logs the request line at DEBUG, so the access key now goes through the redaction filter regardless of source.

title: Phase 4: mcp-gateway-connect stdio bridge
description: bridge.py stdin<->WS pump, second console entrypoint, make connect target, claude mcp add line in banner. Reconnect with backoff.
close_reason: bridge.py + mcp-gateway-connect entrypoint. 14 tests incl. stdout purity, parse-error handling, EOF exit, and survive-a-daemon-restart. Two real bugs found by the tests: the stdin pump raced ahead of the first connection (a client writes initialize the instant it spawns the bridge), and _ClientHungUp was raised in a task nobody awaited so EOF hung instead of exiting. Also: only requests actually sent are failed on a drop, so a queued one survives a reconnect. 219 tests green.

title: Phase 2: backend MCP stdio client
description: Lift mcp_stdio.py+md from python-acp with env_replace/clientInfo/protocol-constants adaptations; protocol.py; backend.py; tests/fixtures/mock_backend.py.
acceptance_criteria: test_backend_env plus lifted mcp_stdio subset (pagination bound, protocol counter-offer, shutdown escalation, stderr drain)
close_reason: mcp_stdio.py lifted with 4 documented divergences (env_replace, clientInfo, protocol constants moved to protocol.py, cwd). protocol.py, backend.py with the curated-env layers, tests/fixtures/mock_backend.py (24 knobs), conftest.py leak guard retargeted and verified to fail a run. 139 tests green.

title: Phase 1: config, secrets, naming, errors
description: config.py (servers.yaml), secrets.py (gateway.env parser + ${VAR} interpolation), logging_redaction.py, naming.py, errors.py, --check/--list flags. No processes, no sockets.
acceptance_criteria: test_config, test_secrets, test_interpolation, test_redaction, test_naming, test_errors pass
close_reason: config.py, secrets.py, logging_redaction.py, naming.py, errors.py plus --check/--list wired into cli.py. 112 tests passing; full gate green (lint, docs-check, test, build).

title: Phase 0: repo scaffolding
description: pyproject.toml, Makefile with stamped venv, scripts/{venv_bootstrap,check_docs,container_image}.py, Containerfile, LICENSE, CI workflows, .gitignore (gateway.env), src/mcp_gateway/__init__.py, cli.py stub.
acceptance_criteria: make venv lint docs-check test build all green; test_version, test_check_docs, test_makefile_targets pass
close_reason: Scaffolding complete: pyproject, Makefile (stamped venv), three lifted scripts, start-gateway.sh, Containerfile, both CI workflows, .gitignore with gateway.env, cli.py with the full parser + configure_logging, README. make venv/lint/docs-check/test/build all green.

title: MCP Gateway daemon (epic)
description: WebSocket MCP gateway daemon with consolidated credential store in gateway.env, fanning out to stdio backend MCP subprocesses. Plan: ~/.claude/plans/i-want-a-mcp-snoopy-tulip.md
close_reason: All 11 phases complete. WebSocket MCP gateway daemon with consolidated credential store, stdio backend pool, namespaced aggregation, reload on resolved spawn identity, /admin channel, and a stdio bridge. 346 tests, full CI gate green, verified end to end against a live daemon.

title: Phase 10: docs and release
description: README, ARCHITECTURE (Mermaid), CHANGELOG, servers.yaml, gateway.env.example, launchd plist, test_container_image.
acceptance_criteria: make docs-check green; container image builds
close_reason: README, ARCHITECTURE.md (Mermaid), CHANGELOG.md, servers.yaml + gateway.env.example (both validated by tests), launchd plist, test_container_image.py (8 tests incl. plist validity and 'the example covers every reference'). Full gate green: lint, docs-check, 346 tests, build.

title: Phase 9: /admin read-only channel
description: admin.status/backends/health/config.get/secrets.keys/logs.tail; admin.reload and admin.backend.restart share the gateway__* implementation.
close_reason: admin_channel.py: the /admin JSON-RPC method table (status, backends, health, config.get with UNRESOLVED refs, secrets.keys, logs.tail/stop, reload, backend.restart), sharing admin.py's implementations with the gateway__* tools. LogStream installed after the redaction filter and re-pointed on reload. 18 tests incl. 'no admin method returns a secret value' across the whole surface and 'admin verbs are absent from the model's tool list'. 338 tests green. Found: admin.status counted only initialized /mcp sessions, so it reported nothing attached while a UI sat on /admin — now enumerated from the server's links.

title: Phase 8: reload
description: supervisor.reload() diffing on resolved spawn identity, gateway__reload_config, gateway__restart_backend, SIGHUP, redaction re-install.
acceptance_criteria: test_reload passes: unchanged backends keep pid, rotated one restarts, exactly one list_changed
close_reason: supervisor.plan_reload/reload diffing on RESOLVED spawn identity (sha256 of command/args/cwd/env_mode/timeouts/enabled + resolved env), drain-then-replace for changed backends, load-then-replace so a bad parse changes nothing. gateway.reload with a lock, redaction re-install, and one list_changed per kind. 'restarting' gets its own message because it resolves on retry. 320 tests green. SIGHUP verified live: rotated backend got a new pid, the untouched one kept its own, no secret in the log.

title: Phase 6: prompts and resources
description: Extend catalogue/router; wire mcpgw:// URI mapper incl. templates.
close_reason: Prompts and resources fan out through catalogue/router. 16 tests: namespacing, capability-gated fetching, the mcpgw:// URI scheme incl. two backends publishing the identical URI, RFC 6570 templates surviving encoding, and the per-method error policy. 276 tests green.

title: Phase 7: notifications, cancellation, passthrough, multi-client
description: notifications.py fan-out + debounce; contextvars origin-connection rule; capability union on connect/disconnect; disconnect cancellation.
close_reason: notifications.py (per-kind debounce, progress to the originating connection, message logged not relayed, resources/updated dropped), reverse passthrough with capability gating, cancellation propagation, multi-client capability union. 307 tests green. Found a real bug the tests were the only thing that could catch: a contextvars.ContextVar does NOT reach the backend's server-request handler, because mcp_stdio dispatches it from the read-loop task created in start() — a task copies its context at creation, so a value set by a later call is invisible. Origin is now tracked explicitly on the Backend, and two clients mid-call on one backend is an honest refusal rather than a coin flip. Also fixed a deadlock in the mock fixture: it polled for the client's answer inside its own stdin loop.

title: Restart backoff for a backend that crashes on every call
description: consecutive_failures is tracked; add exponential backoff so a crash-looping backend does not burn CPU.

title: Lazy backend spawn with idle TTL
description: Eager spawn was chosen for v1. A 20-backend daemon will want lazy spawn plus idle-TTL teardown.

title: resources/subscribe + resources/updated URI rewriting
description: Currently subscribe:false and updated notifications are dropped. Needs mcpgw:// rewriting on the updated notification path.

title: Authorization-header-only WS auth, retire ?key=
description: Query-param keys land in access logs. Move to Authorization: Bearer only once the bridge and UI both send headers.

title: Streamable-HTTP transport (bridge-free path for Claude Code)
description: Serve MCP streamable HTTP on the same port so clients can attach natively without mcp-gateway-connect.

title: Gateway admin UI
description: Web UI over the /admin WS path: config CRUD (admin.config.set), secret management (admin.secrets.set — /admin only, never /mcp), backend add/remove, live status and log streaming.
